title: Local Starburst Conditions and Formation of GRB 980425/SN 1998bw within a Collisional Ring
question: What are the molecular gas properties and depletion times on cloud scales near GRB 980425 in ESO 184-G82, and was the progenitor formed in situ or ejected from a starburst cluster?

data.sensitivity: ~0.4 mJy/beam/channel near line, ~0.6 at primary beam edges

evidence.quote: We therefore adopt a full metallicity range of $0.28-0.44\,Z_{\odot}$ reported by (cite: Kruhler17-2017A&A...602A..85K)
we adopt the metallicity-dependent $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ suggested by (cite: Wolfire10-2010ApJ...716.1191W)
We also assume a ratio of 0.8 for the brightness temperature luminosity of the CO(2-1) to CO(1-0) lines
which was identified through Hi 21 cm emission observations presented in (cite: Arabsalmani19-2019MNRAS.485.5411A)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image CO(2-1) cube and continuum
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration, imaging with Briggs robust=0.5, 3 km/s channels; continuum from 227.7-228.5 and 228.7-229.4 GHz
Local peaks in moment-0 separated by at least one beam; accept if detected in >=2 adjacent channels with total >=5 sigma; PV diagrams checked for substructure

recipe.goal: Measure fluxes, luminosities and line widths
recipe.method: Integrate adjacent channels above rms; significance = flux/(sqrt(N) x rms); FWHM from moment-2 max and Gaussian fits, corrected for resolution
M_mol from L'CO(2-1) with r21=0.8 and alpha_CO=12-40

recipe.goal: Compute SFR and depletion times per gas complex
recipe.method: Total Halpha flux from MUSE in CO-defined regions, Kennicutt98 calibration, Salpeter IMF, no extinction correction; tau_dep = M_mol/SFR

recipe.goal: Upper limit on depletion time at GRB position
recipe.method: 3 sigma per channel over >=2 channels in ~150 pc region at GRB position

evidence.quote: We detect eleven molecular gas clumps in the galaxy, seven of which are within the gas ring.
We measured an integrated flux of $0.197 \pm 0.064$ mJy for the continuum in this region
We find the molecular gas depletion times to show a variation of 1.9 dex

answer_key.quantity: Upper limit tau_dep at GRB position

evidence.quote: we estimate an upper limit of $0.37-1.25$ Gyr for the molecular gas depletion time at the GRB position

answer_key.quantity: Offset of GRB from nearest clumps C8-C9

evidence.quote: The location of GRB 980425 is offset by about 1.6$^{\prime\prime}$  ($\sim$280 pc) from the centre of the closest clumps, C8-C9
